Code95 · 57357 · Healthcare

57357 patient appointment portal

An appointment experience with filters, details, reminders, notes, and QR access.

  • Nuxt 3
  • Tailwind CSS
  • PrimeVue
  1. Find appointments
  2. Open details
  3. Manage reminders

Challenge

Patients needed a way to find and review appointments, open a specific appointment directly, and manage its associated details.

My contribution

I implemented list and grid views with filtering, a server-rendered appointment details route, and dialogs for reminders and QR access. I also built the notes editor.

Outcome

Patients could browse appointments and access related information from the portal.
